package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type t14AssignedPathReader struct {
	path              domain.StudentLearningPath
	err               error
	calls             int
	studentID, pathID string
}

func (reader *t14AssignedPathReader) GetLearningPathByID(_ context.Context, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	reader.calls++
	reader.studentID = studentID
	reader.pathID = pathID
	return reader.path, reader.err
}
func t14UsecasePath() domain.StudentLearningPath {
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusArchived, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", LessonRevisionID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"old","excerpt":"","description":"old content"}`)}}}
}

func TestT14AssignedReadExactPathAndFrozenStrings(t *testing.T) {
	p := t14UsecasePath()
	reader := &t14AssignedPathReader{path: p}
	uc := AssignedLessonContext{Paths: reader}
	first, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), p.StudentID, p.ID, p.Items[0].ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), p.StudentID, p.ID, p.Items[0].ID)
	if err != nil || first != second {
		t.Fatalf("frozen read changed %v", err)
	}
	if reader.calls != 2 || reader.studentID != p.StudentID || reader.pathID != p.ID || first.Content.Title != "old" {
		t.Fatalf("wrong read %#v %#v", reader, first)
	}
}
func TestT14AssignedReadRejectsForeignMissingAndOutage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*t14AssignedPathReader)
		want   error
	}{
		{"foreign owner", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.path.StudentID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" }, domain.ErrNotFound},
		{"foreign path", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.path.ID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" }, domain.ErrNotFound},
		{"foreign item", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.path.Items[0].ID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" }, domain.ErrNotFound},
		{"missing path", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.err = domain.ErrNotFound }, domain.ErrNotFound},
		{"missing frozen content", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.path.Items[0].LessonContent = nil }, domain.ErrValidation},
		{"outage", func(r *t14AssignedPathReader) { r.err = domain.ErrConflict }, domain.ErrConflict},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			p := t14UsecasePath()
			itemID := p.Items[0].ID
			reader := &t14AssignedPathReader{path: p}
			tc.mutate(reader)
			result, err := (AssignedLessonContext{Paths: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), p.StudentID, p.ID, itemID)
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) || result.Schema != "" || reader.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v result=%#v calls=%d", err, result, reader.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT14AssignedReadInvalidIdentifiersBeforeStorage(t *testing.T) {
	p := t14UsecasePath()
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		ids := []string{p.StudentID, p.ID, p.Items[0].ID}
		ids[i] = "bad"
		reader := &t14AssignedPathReader{path: p}
		_, err := (AssignedLessonContext{Paths: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), ids[0], ids[1], ids[2])
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || reader.calls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid identity reached storage: %v", err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := (AssignedLessonContext{}).Handle(context.Background(), p.StudentID, p.ID, p.Items[0].ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("missing reader accepted")
	}
}
